source: 服务器不支持分段，使用单连接
en: The server does not support ranges; using one connection

source: 服务器拒绝分段，已切换单连接
en: The server rejected ranges; switched to one connection

source: 文件大小未知，使用单连接
en: Unknown file size; using one connection

source: 最大并发连接数必须在 1 到 32 之间。
en: Maximum connections must be between 1 and 32.

source: GitHub 镜像仅适用于不带查询参数的公开发布文件与原始文件；其他直链请选择原始直链。
en: GitHub mirrors support public release/raw links without a query; choose Original direct link for other URLs.

source: 文件直链高速下载 | 自动拆分任务与失败重试，速度取决于服务器和网络。
en: High-speed direct-link downloads | Automatic splitting and retries; speed depends on the server and network.

source: 单击选择 | 箭头展开组件 | 推断标签可能有误，请谨慎甄别
en: Click to select | Use arrows to expand | Inferred labels may be incorrect; check them carefully

source: 按需优化内存、下载文件与查看实时性能。
en: Optimize memory, download files and view live performance.

source: 自动选择 GitHub 加速源
支持文件直链与 GitHub 发布文件；无法绕过网站登录或访问限制。
en: Supports direct file links and GitHub release files. Website authentication and access restrictions still apply.

source: 下载链接将发送到所选加速服务。第三方服务可能记录链接或修改文件，仅适用于公开链接，请勿填写私有链接。带查询参数的链接不参与加速。建议填写可信来源提供的 SHA256。是否继续？
en: The download URL will be sent to the acceleration service. Third parties may log URLs or alter files. Use public links only; do not enter private links. Links with query parameters are excluded from acceleration. Enter a SHA256 from a trusted source when available. Continue?
Download paused. You can resume it.

source: 未完成的下载将取消，临时分段会清理。已完成文件不会删除。
en: The unfinished download will be cancelled and temporary parts removed. Completed files will be kept.

source: 请选择完整的下载目录。
文件名无效，不能使用保留名称或路径字符。
en: Invalid file name. Reserved names and path characters are not allowed.

source: 并发连接数必须在 1 到 8 之间。
SHA256 必须为 64 位十六进制字符串。
仅支持不含用户密码或片段的 HTTP 与 HTTPS 文件链接。
en: Only HTTP and HTTPS file URLs without credentials or fragments are supported.

source: 加速仅支持不带查询参数的公开 GitHub 发布文件与原始文件链接。
en: Acceleration supports public GitHub release and raw-file URLs without query parameters.

source: 使用第三方下载源需要先确认。
en: Confirm before using a third-party download source.

source: 目标文件已存在，请更换文件名。
en: The destination exists. Choose a different file name.

source: SHA256 校验失败，文件未保存到目标位置。
en: SHA256 verification failed. The file was not published to the destination.

source: 下载文件长度与服务器不符。
en: The download length does not match the server.

source: 加速源返回了网页，未返回目标文件。
en: The acceleration source returned a web page instead of the file.

source: 服务器返回的分段信息无效。
en: The server returned invalid range metadata.

source: 服务器返回的分段数据无效。
en: The server returned invalid range data.

source: 服务器提前结束了传输，可继续重试。
en: The server ended the transfer early. You can retry.

source: 服务器返回了超出预期的数据。
en: The server returned more data than expected.

source: 远程文件已变化，请重新开始下载。
en: The remote file changed. Restart the download.

source: 按需执行，可能短暂卡顿。白名单不豁免。
en: Run when needed. Brief stalls may occur. Whitelisted apps are included.

source: 将处理整机工作集、文件缓存、修改页、待机页、注册表缓存与相同内存页。部分步骤使用未公开的 Windows 接口，旧系统可能不支持。
en: Processes system working sets, file cache, modified pages, standby pages, registry cache and identical pages. Some steps use undocumented Windows interfaces that may be unavailable on older systems.

source: 将收缩整机工作集、写回修改页并清理待机页。
en: Trims system working sets, writes modified pages back and clears standby pages.

source: 所有程序都会受影响，包括白名单程序。可能短暂卡顿或增加磁盘读取，内存占用可能随后回升。此操作不关闭程序。是否继续？
en: All programs are affected, including whitelisted apps. Brief stalls or extra disk reads may occur, and memory usage may rise again. Programs will not be closed. Continue?
This step is unsupported on this system

source: 已取消尚未执行的步骤。
内存变化包含其他程序的活动，不代表释放了相同数量的已提交内存。
en: The change includes other programs' activity and is not a measure of freed committed memory.
Some optimization steps did not complete

source: 选择当前列表中显示的应用和子项目，不更改白名单。
en: Select visible apps and child items without changing whitelist rules.

source: 已启用的页面会保留匹配程序；内存优化始终处理所有程序。
en: Enabled pages protect matching apps. Memory optimization always includes all programs.

source: 白名单作用范围已保存
白名单保护已阻止停用
en: Whitelist protection blocked disabling this item

source: 内存优化与下载功能的行为参考；独立实现，未包含其源代码。
en: Behavior reference for memory optimization and downloads. Independently implemented without its source code.

source: 工具页面交互的行为参考；独立实现，未包含其源代码。
en: Behavior reference for tool-page interaction. Independently implemented without its source code.

source: 单击选择 | 箭头展开进程 | 勾选保留
en: Click to select | Arrow to expand processes | Keep on the right

source: 单击选择 | 箭头展开进程 | 规则自动保存
en: Click to select | Arrow to expand processes | Rules save automatically

source: 无法核实关键进程标志，已保守保护此进程。
en: The critical-process flag could not be verified. This process is protected.

source: 下载已取消，部分临时文件未能清理。
en: Download cancelled; some temporary files could not be removed.

source: 临时下载文件未能清理
en: Download temporary files could not be removed
